Nov. 19th Irene & Dorothy Schmidt - Ypsilanti - wayward
Patrick Cunningham - 42 - in Eloise - unfortunate marriage ... nerveous brake-
Catherine McEachan of Sarnia - 33 - Kidney - complications ... two major operations - on table 17 times in 22 month - two blood clots. Enrolled when given up .... in perfect health here To-day - Thank .... for prayers ....
Josephine Richards - camcer - breast removed sometime ago - not well. Bernice Binnville - 20 - tape worm
Thanks - Marlene Klein - 6 - was inward bleeder - day before she came hither 2 year ago ... was prayed for & enrolled ... had five hemorages day before ... has never bled since. Deo Gr.
Page 91 Nov. 23
Frank Rouland - 50 - inward cancer
Mrs. Ida La Fave - 30 - fearfully scalded - husband and five wmall ch. .. . Enrolled To-night
Mrs. M. Sills - wants work in day time so to be able to get to church ..
26 Dolore Wemhoff of Humphrey, Neb. - 9 - had a fall when baby disabled jaw - has serious difficulty in opening her mouth to receive Holy Com- munion
Helene La Montagne - of Schenectody, N.Y. ... Thanksgiving for health - espec. as escaping mastoids.
28 Martha J. Hall - 63 - Episcopelian - Kalamazoo - Heart ... Enrolled To- day -
Katherine Methen - colaps of intestines - "hopeless"
Frank Hart - 42 - Stomach-cancer feared: has had two operations in yr. Has wife and two small children. Dr's give no hope ...
Julia Lyons - 57 - broke leg - is cook in St. Vincents ....
